<?php
// Smoke-suite fixture: keep TEC's first-run onboarding out of wp-admin.
// Options written by the blueprint don't survive TEC's own first bootstrap on
// Playground, so the Guided Setup redirect / wizard modal would hijack whichever
// TEC admin screen a test happens to load first. Filters hold on every request.
add_filter( 'tribe_get_option_tec_onboarding_wizard_visited_guided_setup', '__return_true' );
add_filter( 'tribe_get_option_tec_events_onboarding_page_dismissed', '__return_true' );
add_filter( 'pre_option_tec_onboarding_wizard_data', function () { return [ 'finished' => true ]; } );

<?php
// Smoke-suite fixture: a fake Planning Center, active only while the
// smoke_pco_mock option exists (the blueprint's sync steps set and then delete it).
// Instance smoke-1 is all-day, which PCO sends as local midnight → 23:59:59.
add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function ( $pre, $args, $url ) {
    $m = get_option( 'smoke_pco_mock' );
    if ( ! $m || ! str_contains( $url, 'api.planningcenteronline.com' ) ) return $pre;
    $tz  = wp_timezone();
    $iso = fn( string $when ) => ( new DateTimeImmutable( $when, $tz ) )->setTimezone( new DateTimeZone( 'UTC' ) )->format( 'Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z' );
    $body = (int) $m['status'] !== 200
        ? [ 'errors' => [ [ 'detail' => 'Invalid credentials' ] ] ]
        : [
            'data' => [
                [ 'id' => 'smoke-1', 'type' => 'EventInstance', 'attributes' => [ 'starts_at' => $iso( '+10 days midnight' ), 'ends_at' => $iso( '+10 days 23:59:59' ), 'updated_at' => 'T1' ], 'relationships' => [ 'event' => [ 'data' => [ 'type' => 'Event', 'id' => 'smoke-e1' ] ] ] ],
                [ 'id' => 'smoke-2', 'type' => 'EventInstance', 'attributes' => [ 'starts_at' => $iso( '+12 days 08:00' ), 'ends_at' => $iso( '+12 days 09:00' ), 'updated_at' => 'T1' ], 'relationships' => [ 'event' => [ 'data' => [ 'type' => 'Event', 'id' => 'smoke-e2' ] ] ] ],
            ],
            'included' => [
                [ 'id' => 'smoke-e1', 'type' => 'Event', 'attributes' => [ 'name' => 'Smoke All-Day Event' ] ],
                [ 'id' => 'smoke-e2', 'type' => 'Event', 'attributes' => [ 'name' => $m['name'] ] ],
            ],
            'meta' => [ 'total_count' => 2 ],
        ];
    return [ 'headers' => [], 'body' => wp_json_encode( $body ), 'response' => [ 'code' => (int) $m['status'], 'message' => '' ], 'cookies' => [], 'filename' => null ];
}, 10, 3 );
